description: BlobAccessPointSourceProperties is polymorphic (discriminator sourceType; every subtype carries `connection` + `auth`), and its `connection` (discriminator connectionType: Endpoint | PrivateLink) and `auth` (discriminator authType: AccessKey) are polymorphic too. The converter kept only the base discriminators, so a configuration could not send its endpoint or credentials. Flatten the subtypes onto the base shapes for both the create and update source.
